description: CALL of a stored procedure NESTED inside procedural control flow - an IF branch, a WHILE body, a FOR body. Such a CALL was previously a silent NO-OP; it now executes the procedure with its arguments evaluated in the ENCLOSING procedural scope, through the same multi-language CALL dispatch used at top level, and a bare CALL statement DISCARDS the callee's return value so the caller's own RETURN wins. The FOR case passes the loop counter, and a variable carrying a quote is passed through intact. The binding rule is the other half: a scripting name reaches the CALL, and the callee's own DML, only through the :name form, because Snowflake dispatches CALL as SQL - so a BARE name there is an identifier and fails 'invalid identifier', live-verified, at the call site and inside the callee's body alike. Converted 1:1 from scripting/NestedCallStatementTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
BEGIN IF (1 = 1) THEN CALL log_it('taken'); END IF; RETURN 'done'; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
BEGIN IF (1 = 2) THEN CALL log_it('never'); END IF; RETURN 'done'; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
BEGIN FOR i IN 1 TO 3 DO CALL log_it(:i); END FOR; RETURN 'done'; END
SELECT v FROM call_log ORDER BY v
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
DECLARE i INTEGER DEFAULT 0; BEGIN WHILE (i < 2) DO i := i + 1; CALL log_it('w'); END WHILE; RETURN i; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
DECLARE msg VARCHAR DEFAULT 'it''s fine'; BEGIN IF (1 = 1) THEN CALL log_it(:msg); END IF; RETURN 'done'; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
BEGIN IF (1 = 1) THEN CALL log_it('x'); END IF; RETURN 'caller'; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_it(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (:v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
BEGIN LET v VARCHAR := 'x'; IF (1 = 1) THEN CALL log_it(v); END IF; RETURN 'done'; END
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE log_bare(v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO call_log VALUES (v); RETURN 'logged'; END $$
